blocks.text: UAAP SCHEDULE: Season 89 men’s basketball second round MANILA, Philippines–Not only did University of the Philippines keep its solo lead in the standings, but it also moved closer to securing a twice-to-beat advantage in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball Final Four. UP guard Rey Remogat, one of the team’s leaders, doesn’t want to look too far ahead as he and the rest of the Fighting Maroons would rather keep their focus on what’s next. “Our coaches don’t really talk about that twice-to-beat [advantage], they talk about the everyday process more,” he said after the Maroons’ 82-70 victory over the Adamson […]...
